headline: Paraguay's attorney general resigns over Ueno Bank scandal
summary: Paraguay's attorney general, Emiliano Rolón, resigned amid criticism of his inaction on the Ueno Bank case, which has led to the removal and detention of former president Santiago Peña.
why: The Ueno Bank case touches on financial-system integrity and public trust in Paraguay's institutions, which matter to investors assessing country risk.
original_headline: El fiscal general de Paraguay dimite por el escándalo de Ueno Bank
